age: Each sensor last active before current: last observation, 2-4, 5-8, or 9-16/absent; temporal detail retains shared current+clock
destruction: Within each split and exact current+clock group, rotate whole history to next chronological example, without labels. Offline diagnostic, never deployable predictor. Singleton groups unchanged.
history: 16 observations, every adjacent interval >0 and <=65s; purge cross-split windows
input: Only both raw digital PIR sensors and clock; no temperature/light/sound/CO2/derived CO2 slope or occupancy labels
learning: Two changed integer counters per due receipt; prior strength8; capacity100000; frozen development
metadata_only_exposure: CSV header, date counts and time intervals; 7 dates observed despite official description of 4 collection days; no numeric sensor/label read
quality: Brier improvement >=.01 and balanced accuracy >=.02 over best two current controls; Brier destruction loss >=.005
scope: PIR-only low-bandwidth interface feasibility, few controlled days, correlated examples. No full-sensor superiority, SNN advantage, energy measurement, production adoption or test opening.
support_gate: Each split >=100 per class and >=2 calendar days; >=5 exact current PIR + quarter-hour clock groups with distinct age histories and >=4 observations per opposing future label
task: Independently manually annotated occupancy >0 at two subsequent observations, 60-130s later
